name: Hold Fill
summary: Hold to confirm: the label fills leading to trailing, linear over 2 s, while the finger stays down; .success and the action land on the frame the fill completes. Lifting early or leaving the label retracts it in 0.2 s.

states.motion: scale 0.97, easeOut 0.16 s; fill 0 to 100 % leading to trailing, linear over duration (2 s)
states.haptic: .tap once, on touch-down, before any visual work

states.motion: lifted early or left the label: fill retracts, easeOut 0.20 s; scale back, easeOut 0.16 s. Re-entering does not resume; the next touch-down starts over
confirmed, finger still down: fill holds full 0.12 s, then fades 0.20 s; scale returns with spring(response 0.28, damping 0.72)
states.haptic: .success with onConfirm, on the frame the fill completes

states.motion: the system took the touch: snap to idle, no animation

accessibility.reduceMotion: no scale; the fill still runs because it is the countdown, not decoration
accessibility.voiceOver: accessibility action "Confirm" runs onConfirm without holding

sources: Robinhood Support, buying a stock (swipe up to submit an order), robinhood.com/us/en/support/articles/buying-a-stock
